sector.zh: 半导体 · 数据中心算力

disclaimer.en: Prototype — figures illustrative, verify before use
disclaimer.zh: 原型 — 数据仅供示意，使用前请核实

headline.en: AMD is no longer the cheap alternative — it is the second AI compute platform.
headline.zh: AMD 不再是廉价替代品 —— 它已成为第二个 AI 算力平台。

dek.en: Data Center is now half of revenue and growing ~2x company average. The thesis is no longer “catch up to Intel,” it is “how much of the accelerator TAM does the #2 vendor capture.”
dek.zh: 数据中心已占营收的一半，且增速约为公司平均的两倍。投资逻辑不再是“追赶英特尔”，而是“第二供应商能在加速器市场中拿下多少份额”。

thesis.en: Data Center is the whole story — 49% of mix, growing ~2x company.
thesis.zh: 数据中心就是全部逻辑 —— 占比 49%,增速约为公司两倍。

thesis.en: Margin follows mix — accelerators + EPYC lift non-GAAP GM to 53%.
thesis.zh: 利润率随结构走 —— 加速器 + EPYC 推动非 GAAP 毛利率至 53%。

thesis.en: Underwrite the #2, not the catch-up — share of accelerator TAM is the variable.
thesis.zh: 按“第二名”而非“追赶者”定价 —— 加速器份额是关键变量。

footer.zh: 核心结论 · 一屏论点

headline.zh: 这是 12 个月的价值重估，而非短期脉冲。

dek.en: Price has compounded step-wise with each data-center print rather than on a single headline. The question is durability of the multiple, not direction — the marked prints show where the re-rating happened.
dek.zh: 股价随每一次数据中心业绩兑现而逐级抬升，而非依赖单一消息。问题在于估值倍数能否持续，而非方向 —— 标注的业绩节点显示了重估发生之处。

footer.zh: 示意股价路径 · 动量判读

headline.en: One segment now sets the stock.
headline.zh: 如今,一个板块就决定了股价。

dek.en: Four reportable segments, but Data Center alone explains the re-rating. Gaming and Embedded are cyclically depressed; Client is a steady recovery.
dek.zh: 四个可报告板块,但只有数据中心解释了此次重估。游戏与嵌入式处于周期性低谷;客户端是稳健复苏。

label.zh: 数据中心 — EPYC + Instinct MI
嵌入式 — 赛灵思 FPGA/自适应

bullets.en: Data Center +94% YoY — MI300 ramp + EPYC server share gains compound together.
bullets.zh: 数据中心同比 +94% — MI300 放量与 EPYC 服务器份额提升叠加共振。

bullets.en: Client recovering — PC refresh + AI-PC mix lift average selling price.
bullets.zh: 客户端复苏 — PC 换机周期叠加 AI-PC 拉高平均售价。

bullets.en: Embedded down — post-Xilinx inventory digestion across industrial/comms.
bullets.zh: 嵌入式下滑 — 并购赛灵思后,工业/通信渠道仍在去库存。

bullets.en: Gaming declining by design — console cycle late-stage; not a thesis driver.
bullets.zh: 游戏主动收缩 — 主机周期进入末段;非投资逻辑要点。

footer.zh: 板块结构 · 结构性驱动

headline.en: +$3.1B of net growth hides a violent internal rotation.
headline.zh: 净增 31 亿美元的背后,是一场剧烈的内部轮动。

dek.en: Headline growth is modest. The real story is Data Center adding ~$4.9B while Gaming sheds ~$3.6B — the company is being remade, not just grown.
dek.zh: 表观增速温和。真正的故事是数据中心增加约 49 亿美元,而游戏萎缩约 36 亿美元 —— 公司是在被重塑,而不仅是增长。

footer.en: Revenue bridge · rotation, not just growth
footer.zh: 营收桥 · 轮动而非单纯增长

headline.en: Mix is doing the margin work.
headline.zh: 结构改善正在替公司做毛利率的活。

dek.en: Gross margin climbs as accelerators and EPYC displace console silicon. Operating leverage is the watch-item: opex (R&D + GTM) is rising into the AI roadmap.
dek.zh: 随着加速器与 EPYC 取代主机芯片,毛利率持续上行。需重点关注经营杠杆:为支撑 AI 路线图,研发与市场费用同步攀升。

name.zh: 非 GAAP 经营利润率

callout.en: Read: margin expansion is real but mix-driven — it holds only if Data Center keeps out-growing the rest.
callout.zh: 判读:毛利率扩张是真实的,但由结构驱动 —— 只有数据中心持续快于其他板块,它才能维持。

footer.zh: 利润率轨迹 · 结构主导

headline.en: The moat is software adoption, not silicon.
headline.zh: 护城河是软件采用,而非芯片本身。

dek.en: The hardware is competitive. The durable question is whether ROCm + framework support reaches the switching-cost gravity CUDA already has.
dek.zh: 硬件已具竞争力。真正持久的问题是:ROCm 与框架支持能否达到 CUDA 已具备的转换成本引力。

detail.en: Multi-year share gains vs Intel that prove sticky once qualified into cloud fleets — the durable, fundable part of the moat.
detail.zh: 对英特尔多年持续夺份;一旦进入云厂商机群验证即高度黏着 —— 护城河中可持续、可估值的部分。

detail.en: An MI300 → MI350 → MI400 annual cadence that is now credible on hardware; execution risk is supply, not silicon.
detail.zh: MI300 → MI350 → MI400 的年度节奏在硬件层面已可信;执行风险在供给而非芯片本身。

detail.en: Framework support is rising fast but still trails CUDA's gravity — this layer should be priced as improving, not won.
detail.zh: 框架支持快速提升,但仍落后于 CUDA 引力 —— 该层应按“改善中、尚未确立”定价。

detail.en: Co-design wins with select hyperscalers create real lock-in, but the base is still narrow versus the incumbent.
detail.zh: 与部分云厂商的协同设计中标形成真实锁定,但相对在位者客户基数仍窄。

callout.en: Pricing implication: credit the EPYC franchise fully; price the accelerator moat as improving, not won.
callout.zh: 估值含义:EPYC 业务给予充分溢价;加速器护城河应按“改善中,尚未确立”定价。

footer.en: Moat layers · software is the gate
footer.zh: 护城河分层 · 软件是关口

headline.en: Fabless means concentrated dependency by design.
headline.zh: 无晶圆模式,意味着依赖关系天然集中。

dek.en: AMD owns design and ecosystem; it rents leading-edge capacity. The single-point exposures are advanced nodes, advanced packaging, and HBM — the same chokepoints as every AI vendor.
dek.zh: AMD 拥有设计与生态,但租用先进产能。单点风险集中在先进制程、先进封装与 HBM —— 与所有 AI 厂商同处一个咽喉。

detail.en: TSMC N4/N3 — effectively single-source for the roadmap.
detail.zh: 台积电 N4/N3 — 路线图实质单一来源。

detail.en: CoWoS / SoIC capacity gates MI accelerator volume.
detail.zh: CoWoS / SoIC 产能直接限制 MI 加速器出货。

detail.en: SK Hynix / Samsung / Micron — industry-wide allocation.
detail.zh: SK 海力士 / 三星 / 美光 — 全行业按配额分配。

detail.en: Eased vs 2022 but still cyclical for high-end.
detail.zh: 较 2022 年缓解,但高端仍有周期性。

detail.en: A handful of hyperscalers drive accelerator demand.
detail.zh: 少数云厂商主导加速器需求。

detail.en: China AI-accelerator export rules cap a TAM slice.
detail.zh: 对华 AI 加速器出口规则封顶部分市场。

headline.en: A 2/5 displacement score: AMD wins the second socket, not the first.
headline.zh: 2/5 的替代评分:AMD 拿下第二供应商位,而非首选位。

dek.en: Buyers add AMD for supply diversity and price/perf, rarely to rip out the incumbent. The bull case needs that to shift from dual-source insurance toward primary share.
dek.zh: 买家引入 AMD 是为了供应多元化与性价比,极少为替换在位者。多头逻辑需要这一点从“双源保险”转向“主份额”。

detail.en: CUDA + systems is the switching-cost moat AMD is measured against. AMD wins the second socket on price/perf, rarely the first.
detail.zh: CUDA + 系统构成 AMD 对标的转换成本护城河。AMD 凭性价比拿下第二供应商位,极少拿下首选位。

detail.en: A net server-share donor to AMD; Gaudi accelerator traction has stayed limited and is not a near-term threat.
detail.zh: 服务器份额持续向 AMD 流失;Gaudi 加速器进展有限,短期内非威胁。

detail.en: TPU / Trainium / Maia cap the merchant accelerator TAM at the very top — a permanent ceiling on #1+#2 combined.
detail.zh: TPU / Trainium / Maia 在顶部封顶第三方加速器市场 —— 对第一名+第二名合计构成永久天花板。

detail.en: Pressures the x86 franchise at the power-efficiency edge over a multi-year horizon rather than head-on today.
detail.zh: 在多年维度上从能效侧挤压 x86 业务,而非当下正面竞争。

footer.zh: 竞争图谱 · 第二供应商逻辑

headline.en: The next two prints are the whole debate.
headline.zh: 接下来两次业绩,就是全部分歧所在。

dek.en: Each event is a check on the same variable: is the accelerator ramp tracking the roadmap, or slipping a quarter?
dek.zh: 每个事件都在检验同一个变量:加速器放量是按路线图推进,还是延后一个季度?

note.en: First clean read on MI350 contribution + DC mix.
note.zh: 首个关于 MI350 贡献与数据中心结构的清晰读数。

watch.en: DC revenue run-rate vs the implied MI350 ramp curve.
watch.zh: 数据中心营收年化值 vs MI350 隐含放量曲线。

watch.en: Any CoWoS/HBM allocation commentary on the call.
watch.zh: 电话会上任何关于 CoWoS/HBM 配额的措辞。

note.en: MI400 / Helios rack systems detail + customers.
note.zh: MI400 / Helios 机架系统细节与客户。

watch.en: Named rack-scale customers, not just specs.
watch.zh: 公布机架级客户名单,而不仅是规格。

note.en: Rack-scale is the credibility test vs NVIDIA.
note.zh: 机架级方案是对标英伟达的可信度考验。

watch.en: Shipping rack systems vs slideware timelines.
watch.zh: 实际出货机架系统 vs PPT 时间表。

footer.zh: 时点催化剂 · 未来约 12 个月

headline.en: Consensus is constructive but the dispersion is wide.
headline.zh: 市场共识偏正面,但分歧区间很宽。

dek.en: Most of the street is Buy, but the target range is unusually wide — the disagreement is entirely about accelerator share, not the core franchise.
dek.zh: 多数卖方为买入,但目标价区间异常宽 —— 分歧完全在于加速器份额,而非核心业务。

footer.zh: 卖方分布 · 持仓定位

headline.en: The same company is a 0.7x or a 3x — entry and share decide it.
headline.zh: 同一家公司,可能是 0.7 倍或 3 倍 —— 取决于买点与份额。

dek.en: Return is dominated by two variables: accelerator share captured by FY27 and the multiple the market pays for #2 vs duopoly status.
dek.zh: 回报由两个变量主导:到 FY27 拿下的加速器份额,以及市场为“第二名 vs 双寡头”支付的倍数。

callout.en: Sensitivity: entry above the base multiple subtracts roughly a full turn of MoIC for the same operating outcome.
callout.zh: 敏感性:买点高于基准倍数,在相同经营结果下大约抹去整整一倍 MoIC。

footer.zh: 情景泳道 · 对买点敏感

headline.en: Six gates turn ACCUMULATE into conviction — or into a pass.
headline.zh: 六道关卡,决定“增持”升级为重仓,还是放弃。

dek.en: A polished report should not hide what it does not yet know. These are the exact checks that move commitment decisions.
dek.zh: 一份精致的报告不应掩盖尚未确知之处。以下正是决定仓位大小的检验项。

body.en: Merchant GPU share trending toward double digits by FY27.
body.zh: 到 FY27 第三方 GPU 份额向两位数迈进。

metric.en: Need: merchant GPU share > 10% by FY27E
metric.zh: 需达成:FY27E 第三方 GPU 份额 > 10%

body.en: Independent shops shipping on ROCm, not just lighthouse accounts.
body.zh: 独立团队在 ROCm 上落地,而不仅是标杆客户。

metric.zh: 需达成:3 个以上非标杆 ROCm 案例

body.en: CoWoS / HBM allocation rising fast enough to meet bookings.
body.zh: CoWoS / HBM 配额提升足以满足在手订单。

metric.en: Need: stated allocation growth ≥ booking growth
metric.zh: 需达成:配额增速 ≥ 订单增速

body.en: GM holds 55%+ as accelerators scale (not dilutive).
body.zh: 加速器放量后毛利率守住 55%+(非摊薄)。

metric.zh: 需达成:FY26E 前非 GAAP 毛利率 ≥ 55%

body.en: Revenue concentration easing beyond a few hyperscalers.
body.zh: 营收集中度从少数云厂商扩散开。

metric.en: Need: top-3 customer mix trending down
metric.zh: 需达成:前三大客户占比下行

body.en: Accumulate into multiple compression, not into momentum highs.
body.zh: 在倍数压缩时增持,而非在动量高点追入。

metric.zh: 规则:仅在 < 28 倍前瞻估值时加仓

footer.en: Decision gates · preserve the right to say no
footer.zh: 决策关卡 · 保留说不的权利

dek.en: This prototype uses illustrative figures. In production every number is null-over-invented and carries the source below.
dek.zh: 本原型使用示意数据。在正式版本中,每个数字“宁缺勿造”,并附下列来源。
